title: Tessera-ST: a gated graph encoder for spatial omics and its controls audit
description: Tessera-ST is a self-supervised gated graph encoder for spatial molecular data; earlier releases call it Tessera. This version contains the evaluated implementation, the controls audit of the original submission and the analyses added during review (training budget, patient-excluded tuning of the encoder, cluster number with fixed representations, native external methods, and exploratory extensions to wider encoder graphs, earlier checkpoints and more breast seeds), with their written protocol, tests, result tables and reproduction guide. Author-owned software is MIT licensed; author-generated text, figures and result aggregates are CC BY 4.0; third-party measurements, annotations and images retain their source-specific terms.
notes: The earlier versions are doi:10.5281/zenodo.23308077 (2026.10.11-controls-audit) and doi:10.5281/zenodo.23101191 (2026.10.02-author-review). No manuscript DOI is asserted here.
